case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Reviews consistently praise the hotel's central location, renovated/modern rooms, cleanliness, comfortable beds and attentive, friendly staff, with many guests noting plush towels and bathroom amenities. Negative comments include street/noise and staff noise, occasional housekeeping lapses (rooms not cleaned or beds not made), breakfast not included/limited, missing in-room amenities (fridge, blinds), water pressure and shower screen issues, and reception not at street level.
